title: BCCWJ-MEG
description: This MEG dataset comprises continuous magnetoencephalographic recordings from 35 Japanese native speakers during word-by-word reading of Japanese newspaper articles. Part of the BCCWJ-Brain collection, it enables cross-modality comparisons of language processing by providing high temporal resolution neural data acquired using identical stimuli across separate fMRI, MEG, and EEG cohorts. The dataset includes raw MEG data, preprocessed MEG data (with CALM filtering, ICA artifact removal, and bandpass filtering), anatomical MRI images, and detailed documentation of acquisition and analysis procedures. Note: BCCWJ texts are not copyright-free and are not included in this dataset; users must register separately for access at https://bccwj-data.ninjal.ac.jp/.
methods_description: MEG data were acquired using a 200-channel whole-head system with axial gradiometers at 1,000 Hz sampling rate with 200 Hz online low-pass filtering. Stimuli (20 Japanese newspaper articles) were presented word-by-word via rapid serial visual presentation (500 ms stimulus, 500 ms blank). Preprocessing included CALM filtering, ICA-based artifact removal, 0.1–40 Hz bandpass filtering, epoching (−100 to 1,000 ms relative to word onset), downsampling to 200 Hz, and baseline correction. T1-weighted structural images were also acquired and defaced using PyDeface.
